testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a command in the expanded panel across tab switches: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:292:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a command in the expanded panel across tab switches ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible ✔ And Shell is in the Modify main panel ✔ When the user moves Shell to the expanded panel using its context menu ✔ And the user selects Tools and then returns to 3D Model ✔ Then Shell is absent from the Modify main panel ✔ When the user opens the Modify expanded panel ✔ Then Shell is available in the expanded panel ✔ When the user moves Shell back to the main panel using its context menu ✔ Then Shell appears in the main Modify panel ✔ And the part remains visible
